NONE: › when you want to and when you have time to
在有空的時候，空閒時

example: You can take the documents home and study them at (your) leisure.
你可以把這些檔帶回家，有空時再好好看一看。

NONE: › in a bad or weak state
處於低潮；處於衰退狀態

example: Consumer confidence is currently at a low ebb.
目前人們對消費的信心降到了谷底。
I was recently divorced and feeling at a very low ebb.
我剛離了婚，情緒非常低落。

NONE: › used to emphasize how little time someone has to do something or how little warning is given
（用於強調只有極少時間完成某事）提前一會兒/兩個小時/三個星期（等等）通知

example: We can't be expected to just drop everything and leave at a moment's notice.
不可要求我們能在接到通知後放下所有的事情立即離開。

NONE: › Something that you can do at a pinch can be done if it is really necessary, but it will be difficult, not perfect, or not what you would really like
必要時；在緊要關頭

example: I need £2,000 to set up the business, but I suppose £1,500 would do at a pinch.
我需要2000英鎊來創辦這間公司，不過實在湊不夠的話，1500英鎊也可以。

NONE: › If you can do something at a push, you can do it but it will be difficult.
困難地

example: At a push I could be there by eight o'clock.
我勉強能在八點之前趕到。

NONE: › If someone does something at a rate of knots, they do it very quickly.
很快地，飛快地，迅速地

example: She got through her work at a rate of knots.
她很快做完了工作。

NONE: › extremely slowly
非常慢地，緩慢地

example: The roads were full of traffic and we were travelling at a snail's pace for two hours.
路上全是車，我們如蝸牛爬行般行駛了兩個小時。

NONE: › (used to make negatives and questions stronger) in any way or of any type
（用於否定句和疑問句，表示強調）根本，無論如何，絲毫，一點兒

example: He's had no food at all.
他一點兒東西都沒吃。
I haven't been at all well recently.
最近我身體壞透了。
I'm afraid I have nothing at all to say.
抱歉，我沒有任何可說的。
Is there any uncertainty at all about the way she died?
對於她的死因，有沒有任何疑點？
Why bother getting up at all when you don't have a job to go to?
你沒有工作，不用去上班，還起床做甚麼呢？

NONE: B2 If something must be done or avoided at all costs, it must be done or avoided whatever happens.
不惜任何代價；無論如何

example: Security during the president's visit must be maintained at all costs.
要不惜一切代價確保總統在訪問期間的安全。
He wanted her at any cost, even if it meant giving up everything he had.
他不惜一切代價要得到她，即使這意味著放棄他自己所擁有的一切。

NONE: C2 If you want something at any price, you are willing to do anything in order to get it.
不惜任何代價，無論如何

example: He wanted success at any price.
為了成功他不惜任何代價。

NONE: C2 whatever happens
無論如何，不管怎樣
› something you say to show that you are going to say something more exactly
（表示更確切地說明）不管怎樣，至少

example: Well, I'm not going home on foot, at any rate.
哼，無論如何我都不會步行回家。
I don't think they liked my idea. At any rate, they weren't very enthusiastic about it.
我覺得他們不喜歡我的主意，至少他們不是很熱心。

NONE: › taking your turn to try to hit the ball in a baseball game
出場擊球
› If an animal is at bay, it is about to be caught or attacked.
（動物）被包圍，走投無路
› in a basic way
事實上；本質上

example: Jealousy is, at bottom, a lack of self-confidence.
嫉妒本質上是缺乏自信。

NONE: › (from) a short distance away
（在）近距離

example: When you see famous people at close quarters, they always appear much smaller than you imagined them.
近距離看名人時，他們看起來往往比你想像中要平凡得多。
He was shot at close range.
他是被近距離槍殺的。

NONE: › If two people are at each other's throats, they are arguing angrily.
（兩人）激烈爭吵

example: Those two are always at each other's throats.
那兩人總是吵個沒完。

NONE: › If something unpleasant happens at every turn, it happens every time you try to do something.
每次；總是；處處；事事

example: They do their best to frustrate my efforts at every turn.
他們每次都竭力挫敗我的努力。

NONE: B1 in or at the beginning
起初，起先

example: At first, I thought he was joking but then I realized he meant it.
起初我以為他在開玩笑，後來才意識到他是認真的。

NONE: › as fast as possible
全速地；盡快

example: The plant is operating at full tilt to cope with demand.
為應付需求，這家工廠全速生產。

NONE: › at full/half speed or power
以全速／半速；盡全力／以一半的力量

example: He's working at full throttle (= as hard as he can) to get the job finished.
他正全力以赴完成工作。
The captain of the boat had his engines at full throttle.
船長讓船開足馬力全速行駛。

NONE: C1 near in time or position
（時間上）臨近；在附近

example: We want to ensure that help is at hand (= easily available) for all children suffering abuse.
我們想確保所有遭受虐待的兒童都能隨時得到幫助。

NONE: C2 used to say what someone is really like
（某人）真正的樣子

example: He had dozens of friends, but he was a private person at heart.
他有幾十個朋友，但其實是一個很私密的人。

NONE: › Someone who is put in prison at His/Her Majesty's pleasure is kept there until it is officially decided that it is safe to release them
留置；坐牢

example: He was declared insane and ordered to be detained in a mental hospital at Her Majesty's pleasure.
他被指患精神病，被拘禁在一所精神醫院。

NONE: C2 generally
普遍地，全體地

example: This group is not representative of the population at large.
這個團體不是全體人民的代表。

NONE: A2 as much as, or more than, a number or amount
至少
B2 used to reduce the effect of a statement
反正，不管怎樣
B1 used to emphasize that something is good in a bad situation
至少，還好，不管怎麽說
B1 used to say that someone should do something small, even if they do nothing else
至少，起碼

example: It will be £200 at the very least.
那東西最少也要200鎊。
You'll have to wait at least an hour.
你至少要等一個小時。
I've met the president - at least, he shook my hand once.
我見到總統了——不管怎樣他和我握了一下手。
See also
leastways
It's a small house but at least there's a garden.
那是一座小房子，但不管怎麽說還有一個花園呢。
Even if she didn't want to send a present, she could at least have sent a card.
即使不想送禮物，她起碼也應該寄一張賀卡。

NONE: › happy because you feel that you belong in the world and generally agree with what happens
與世界融為一體；與世界和諧相處
› separated from something such as an event by an amount of time, by your feelings, or by other events
疏遠；遠離

example: Charlotte felt she was at one remove from reality.
夏洛特覺得她與現實隔了一步。
At this remove it is difficult to estimate what the total value of the estate was.
隔了這麼久，很難估計這些地產的總價值。
This kind of artistic representation is at many removes from the subject.
這樣的藝術再現與主題相差甚遠。

NONE: › a gentle way of saying that someone is dead
安息，長眠

example: Now she is at peace and her suffering is over.
現在她安息了，痛苦也結束了。

NONE: › always willing and able to do whatever someone asks
聽命於，唯…之命是從

example: Go and get it yourself! I'm not at your beck and call, you know.
自己去拿！我才不聽你使喚呢。

NONE: › close to and a little behind someone
在…近旁；緊隨…之後；緊緊伴隨…

example: During the visit, the interpreter was always at her elbow.
在她參觀的過程中，翻譯始終緊隨其後。

NONE: › confused
困惑的

example: I'm all/completely at sea with the new computer system.
新的電腦系統完全把我搞糊塗了。

NONE: C1 only a short time before something happens
在短時間內；一經通知立即

example: I can't cancel my plans at such short notice.
我無法在這麼短的時間內取消我的安排。

NONE: › in a confused, badly organized, or difficult situation
亂七八糟，雜亂無章

example: We've been at sixes and sevens in the office this week.
我們辦公室這一週忙得不可開交。

NONE: C2 If something that is valuable is at stake, it is in a situation where it might be lost.
有風險；處於危急關頭

example: Thousands of lives will be at stake if emergency aid does not arrive in the city soon.
如果緊急救援物資不能早日運到城中，數千人的生命就會有危險。

NONE: › in addition to that
此外，而且

example: It's too expensive, and probably out-of-date at that.
它太貴了，而且可能已過時了。

NONE: C2 when everything is going well
即使在最好的情況下

example: Our car is slow even at the best of times.
我們的車即使在最佳狀態下也開得不快。

NONE: › doing the work involved in a job, in real working conditions, rather than planning or talking about it
在實際工作崗位；在工作現場；在工作第一線

example: At the coalface with a deadline looming, you sometimes feel under a lot of pressure.
在工作第一線切身面對最後期限的逼近，你有時會感覺壓力很大。

NONE: C2 very early in the morning, especially at the time when the sun first appears
大清早，黎明，破曉時分

example: We'll have to leave at the crack of dawn.
我們天一亮就得動身。

NONE: › If you do something at the drop of a hat, you do it immediately without stopping to think about it.
不加思索地，毫不猶豫地

example: People will file lawsuits at the drop of a hat these days.
現在人們動不動就打官司。

NONE: › something that you say before you give the most important fact of a situation
最終；到頭來；不管怎麽說

example: Of course I'll listen to what she has to say but at the end of the day, it's my decision.
當然她要說甚麽我也會聽，但最終還是我來作決定。

NONE: C2 mainly UK US usually at the end of your rope having no strength or patience left
筋疲力盡；一籌莫展
C2 having no strength or patience left
筋疲力盡；一籌莫展

example: By six o'clock after a busy day I'm at the end of my tether.
忙碌了一天之後，到六點我已筋疲力盡了。
By six o'clock after a busy day, I'm at the end of my tether.
忙碌了一天之後，到六點我已筋疲力盡了。

NONE: C2 making another person look silly
捉弄，戲弄；拿…開心

example: Would you stop making jokes at my expense?
你不要再戲弄我了，好不好？

NONE: C1 If you do one thing at the expense of another, doing the first thing harms the second thing.
以…為代價，在…受損的情況下

example: He had no need to protect their reputation at the expense of his own.
他沒有必要為了保護他們的名譽而犧牲自己的。

NONE: C2 If you suffer at the hands of someone, they hurt you or treat you badly.
被（某人）折磨

example: How many people have died at the hands of terrorist organizations?
有多少人死在恐怖組織手中？

NONE: › very easily
非常容易地；輕易地

example: You can't expect to get everything you need at the push of a button.
你不能指望輕鬆地得到自己需要的一切。

NONE: › used before you say something that may seem offensive or stupid
（表示自己說的話可能造成冒犯或聽起來很蠢）冒著…的風險

example: At the risk of seeming rude, I'm afraid I have to leave now.
恕我失禮，恐怕我現在必須得走了。
At the risk of sounding stupid, how do I send this email?
問一個傻問題，我怎麼寄發電子郵件呢？

NONE: › used to mention something that must be considered in addition to what you have just said
儘管如此

example: No one likes conflict, but at the same time we have to deal with this problem.
沒人喜歡衝突，但儘管如此，我們不得不處理這個問題。

NONE: › If something is done at the stroke of a pen, it is done quickly and easily by someone.
輕而易舉

example: Politicians know they cannot create a lawful society simply at the stroke of a pen.
政治家們都知道，他們無法輕而易舉地創建一個法制社會。

NONE: › extremely loudly
扯破喉嚨地，特別大聲地

example: She shouted his name at the top of her voice.
她大聲呼喊他的名字。

NONE: C2 if the situation stays as it is
照此情形，如此下去

example: At this rate, we won't be home until midnight.
照這樣下去，我們要半夜才能到家。

NONE: › If you can do something at will, you can do it any time you want.
隨心所欲地；自如地

example: He can cry at will.
他想哭就能哭出來。

NONE: › used to say what the most unpleasant or difficult situation could possibly be
往最壞處說；充其量
› considering someone or something in the most negative or unkind way possible
就最壞的那一面看

example: At worst, she can only tell you off for being late.
充其量她也就是會責備你遲到而已。
She is at worst corrupt, and at best has been knowingly breaking the rules.
她最壞的情況是腐敗，而最好的情況是故意違反規定。

NONE: › If you have particular qualities at your command, you are able to use them effectively.
嫺熟，得心應手，運用自如
› humorous If someone says that they are at your command, that person is willing to do what you ask.
聽從…吩咐，任由…安排

example: As a writer, she has both style and humour at her command.
作為一名作家，她對文風和幽默都能運用自如。
"I can't reach my zip - could you unfasten it, please?" "I'm at your command!"
「我觸不到我的拉鍊——請你幫我拉開好嗎？」「遵命！」

NONE: C2 If you have information at your fingertips, you can get it and use it very easily.
近在手邊；很容易得到；隨時可供使用

example: He has all the latest statistics at his fingertips.
他手頭上有所有最新的統計值。

NONE: › If you learned something at your mother's knee, you learned it when you were a child.
在小時候

example: I learned to sew at my mother's knee.
我是小時候學會縫紉的。

NONE: › less active or intelligent than you are at other times
狀態最差
› showing the most unpleasant side of someone's character
表現出最壞的品質，顯出最醜陋的一面

example: I'm at my worst first thing in the morning.
我早上的時候狀態最差。
This problem over late payment has shown him at his worst.
這次拖延付款的問題使他原形畢露。

NONE: › If two people, countries, etc. are at daggers drawn, they are in a state of extreme unfriendliness and do not trust each other.
冷戰（的），相互戒備（的）

example: The two sides have been at daggers drawn for some months now with no sign of improvement in relations.
雙方一連冷戰了好幾個月，到現在依然沒有任何緩和的跡象。

NONE: › as loud as possible
最響亮地，以最大聲音

example: He had the television on at full blast.
他把電視的音量開到了最大。

NONE: › as fast as possible
以最高速度，全速

example: He was driving at full speed down the motorway when it happened.
當時他正在高速公路上全速疾馳。

NONE: › working as hard as possible, so that you could not manage to do any more
全力以赴地

example: The emergency services are working at full stretch today to cope with the accident.
緊急救護隊今天全力以赴地處理這場事故。

before noun: › in danger of being harmed or damaged, or of dying
處於危險之中的；可能遭受傷害的
› in danger of closing or failing
可能倒閉的；可能失敗的

example: Many residents in at-risk areas move their cars to higher ground when floods threaten.
洪水威脅逼近之時，可能受影響區域的很多住戶都把汽車移到了地勢高一些的地方。

NONE: › If you can buy or get something at/for a price, you either have to pay a lot of money or be involved in something unpleasant in order to get it.
以高價；以很高的代價

example: You can buy the best of gourmet cuisine here, for a price.
在這裡你可以出高價吃到最好的美食。

NONE: › If you do something at/in one fell swoop, you do it all at the same time.
一舉，一下子

example: I got all my Christmas shopping done in one fell swoop.
我一次就把聖誕節需要的所有物品都買齊了。

NONE: › during one limited period of time, without stopping
一口氣地

example: I enjoyed the book so much that I read it all in one sitting.
我太喜歡這本書了，一口氣就把它讀完了。

NONE: › If something is at/in the back of your mind, you intend to do it, but are not actively thinking about it.
在潛意識裡，下意識地（覺得）

example: It's been at the back of my mind to call José for several days now, but I haven't got round to it yet.
這幾天我一直打算打電話給喬斯，但至今仍然沒有空。

NONE: › very quickly and without any delay
迅速，馬上，立即
› exactly at a particular time
剛好在…時，正當…的時候

example: Fireworks started at the stroke of ten.
煙火在十點正開始燃放。
